package.description: Archtype.exe is a command line utility that examines executables (".exe"s) and determines whether they are compiled for 32 or 64 bit architectures.

en-US.description: Archtype.exe is a command line utility that examines executables (".exe"s) and determines whether they are compiled for 32 or 64 bit architectures.
en-US.longDescription: It also pulls out the build date, whether symbols are included and some other flags from COFF header.
en-US.name: Archtype
